verdict.rationale: Trigger.dev tasks are plain TypeScript code kept in your own source control. A documented GitHub Actions workflow deploys tasks when code is pushed to main, and the platform supports separate environments and preview branches, with deploys targeting specific environments. Users confirm that keeping workflows in the IDE and codebase simplifies change management, and that Dev mode makes local iteration easy. Missing for 10: an explicit dev-to-production promotion workflow, deployment version pinning or rollback documentation, and independent hands-on corroboration of multi-environment promotion.
